# PHASE 08 — SEARCH, FILTER, AND NAVIGATION

## OBJECTIVE

Make the portfolio explorable like an investigation database.

## GLOBAL SEARCH

Search:

- project title
- project description
- technology
- AWS service
- category
- architecture node
- keyword

Use server-side Python search first.

Optional HTMX for live results.

## FILTERS

Project category:

- Cloud
- DevOps
- Backend
- Data
- IoT
- Fullstack

Technology / service filters:

- AWS
- Docker
- Terraform
- Kubernetes
- Flask
- Python
- EKS
- Lambda
- etc.

## COMMAND PALETTE

Optional shortcut:

`Ctrl + K`

Commands:

- Open Projects
- Open DevOps Case
- Open Cloud AI Case
- Open IaaS Case
- Open IoT Case
- Open Skills
- Open Timeline
- Search
- Contact

Command palette must not become the only navigation mechanism.

## RELATED CASES

When a user opens a technology:

Example:

Kubernetes

Show:

IaaS

EKS
Helm
NetworkPolicy
Terraform

## EXIT CRITERIA

Users can discover projects by title, technology, category, and relationships.
